name: Japan Meteorological Agency Terms of Use
content: Information made available on the Japan Meteorological Agency website (Content) may be used under the Terms of Use, established on 28 January 2016. Use of Content may be restricted by the Meteorological Service Act and related ordinances (Article 17(1), forecasting services licence; Article 23, restriction on warnings: only the Japan Meteorological Agency issues weather, earthquake, tsunami and flood warnings). The Terms do not apply to symbol marks and logos. Full terms: https://www.jma.go.jp/jma/en/copyright.html
